scope: Native HappyRobot mocked text checkpoint and full-conversation tests. Not audio or telephony validation, not a capacity test, not live business outcome data.

safety.checkpoint_actions: All 73 native definitions read back immediately before final run, each with six explicit skip_execution_with_mock_output service actions.
safety.full_conversation_actions: All seven service actions mocked, including call_ended.
safety.side_effects: No real emails, carrier authority requests, TMS booking, Twin writes or production workflow mutations in these tests.
safety.secret_handling: Credentials, runtime headers, email addresses, private ceilings and verification code values excluded/redacted. Fixture code placeholders must be replaced consistently with a synthetic code if replayed.

final_checkpoint_summary.grade_policy: Native failed grades retained unchanged. Reasons below describe differences but do not relabel them as passes.

failures.S2: Native grader required an explicit verified statement plus equipment and lane together. Candidate instead asked one missing detail. This is a legacy expectation mismatch, not evidence of authentication bypass.
failures.S5: Legacy grader expected spoken handoff after close_call returned. Candidate says it via close_call's caller-facing AI message, after the earlier negotiated agreement. Original failure preserved. END tests the changed message contract and passes.

final_checkpoint_summary.manual_limit: Checkpoint passing does not demonstrate end-to-end hangup or immunity to incomplete tool payloads.
